{{Quote|If Lorrd does not act, we will become slaves to an empire once more.|Nee Alavar|<ref name="DITSPOL" />}}
'''Nee Alavar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was one of the [[Delegation of 2000]] senators&mdash;which also included her close friend [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]]&mdash;who tried to convince [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to relinquish his emergency powers. Alavar was arrested and [[Death/Legends|executed]] for her opposition to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] out of the Republic.

==Biography==
===Last days of the Republic===
A [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]],<ref name="DB" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Alavar was serving in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] as [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="DB" /> for the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|18|Alavar, Senator Nee}}</ref> which contained the planet.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Alavar became a member of the [[Delegation of 2000]], a group of senators who had signed the [[Petition of 2000]] to express their concerns with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] policies and call for him to relinquish his [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]].<ref name="DB" />

[[File:PalpatineAndEntourage-ROTS.png|thumb|left|250px|Senator Alavar joined other Senators in greeting Chancellor Palpatine upon his safe return to Coruscant's surface.]]

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ROTS date" /> Alavar was in a group of Senators who gathered at a landing platform in front of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]<ref name="ROTS" /> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to greet [[Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] Palpatine. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Palpatine was successfully rescued from [[Prison/Legends|captivity]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] by two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="ROTS" />

As Palpatine emerged from a [[Jedi shuttlebus/Legends|Jedi shuttlebus]] on the platform, the group of Senators moved forward to greet him, and then followed him back into the executive building.<ref name="ROTS" /> Alavar was later part of a small group of members of the Delegation of 2000 who met with Palpatine in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] in the Executive Building to present him with the Petition of 2000. The group was observed by Skywalker, who noted that neither Alavar nor Senator [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]] spoke during the meeting, hypothesizing that they needed each other for emotional support. The Delegation members, led in the meeting by Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], expressed their concerns with amendments to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]], and Palpatine's powers, though Palpatine made no promises on giving them up.<ref name="ROTS-N">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

===Reign of the Empire===
Not long after, Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], styling himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Members of the Delegation were [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] on charges of [[Treason/Legends|treason]],<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> including Senator Alavar. Due to her signing of the Petition of 2000, and her statements believing that Lorrd needed to rise up to prevent being [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by a new Empire, Alavar was brutally [[Death/Legends|executed]] and her entire [[Nee Alavar's family|family]] was separated and deported to labor camps. Alavar's fate led to the formation of dissident groups on Lorrd in the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], loosely affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Those who joined the Alliance generally left the planet to avoid their family suffering the same fate as Alavar's.<ref name="DITSPOL" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Nee Alavar possessed [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin, and stood at a height of 1.68 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. She had a keen eye for recognizing individuals' body language. She wore covering [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] in order to prevent others from doing the same to her.<ref name="DB" /> Alavar was a close friend of fellow Delegation of 2000 Senator Malé-Dee.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Equipment==
On the landing platform,<ref name="ROTS" /> Alavar wore heavy<ref name="Who's Who" /> gray<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with a hood to prevent others from gleaning her body language.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Continuity===
{{Quote|Taun We was my first ever alien, and a hard act to follow! To be honest, playing a human in, Revenge of the Sith, was boring in comparison. But needless to say, another wonderful experience to be on the Episode 3 set for 3 weeks.|Rena Owen|<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/interviews/vintage-interview-rena-owen-21st-august-2005|text=Vintage Interview: Rena Owen: 21st August 2005|author=[[Mark Newbold|Newbold, Mark]]|date=2005-08-21|work=[https://www.fanthatracks.com Fantha Tracks]|archivedate=20211009140038}}</ref>}}
Nee Alavar was first alluded to by "Nothing Up This Sleeve," an entry in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[Episode III Set Diary]] released on [[July 15]], [[2003]]. There, it was revealed that a Senator would be portrayed by<ref name="Nothing Up That Sleeve">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20030715.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Nothing Up This Sleeve}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:New Zealand|New Zealand]]<ref name="Appearing Knightley">{{InsiderCite|75|Appearing Knightley (and the Women of Star Wars)|Appearing Knightley (and the Women of ''Star Wars'')}}</ref> actress [[Rena Owen]]&mdash;who had previously portrayed [[Taun We]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]&mdash;in the upcoming final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Nothing Up That Sleeve" /> Alavar made her first appearance as a character in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of ''Revenge of the Sith'', written by [[Matthew Stover]]<ref name="ROTS-N" /> and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="ROTS-N release date">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=30059|text=Matthew Woodring Stover}}</ref> and she was first pictured by<ref name="ROTS Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]''</ref> the simultaneously-released<ref name="ROTS Scrapbook release date">{{Amazon|url=/Revenge-Sith-Scrapbook-Star-Wars/dp/0375826114|text=Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook (Star Wars)|archivedate=20160528170422}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Scrapbook]]''.<ref name="ROTS Scrapbook" />

The landing pad scenes featuring the character were filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 22]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> A scene where Alavar and members of the Delegation of 2000 visited the office of the Chancellor<ref name="Deleted">{{Film|III}} Deleted Scene: Confronting the Chancellor</ref> was filmed on [[July 15]] of that year,<ref name="MakingOf" /> but was cut from the final release of ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="Deleted" /> The scene was, however, included in the film's novelization.<ref name="ROTS-N" />

===Portrayal===
{{Quote|When I first read the script, I do remember having a feeling that the scenes might be cut because they weren't intrinsic to the overarching plot of Anakin Skywalker turning to the dark side, but that whole group of senators were so interesting and colorful, and really painted a fascinating picture of Padmé's hopes and fears, both politically and personally.|Rena Owen|<ref name="TaunWe" />}}

[[File:Neealavar.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Rena Owen smiles as Nee Alavar on the set of ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]

Owen considered the human role of Alavar boring compared to her experience as the [[alien]] Taun We, but she enjoyed being on set for the three weeks of filming.<ref name="Interview" /> She was flattered to return, as she felt it meant the she had become part of the family of people that the film makers trusted. Upon reading the script for the deleted scenes, she suspected they might be cut since they did not tie into Anakin Skywalker's story. Nevertheless, she found the group of senators interesting and colorful, while also being important for Padmé Amidala's characterization.<ref name="TaunWe">{{InsiderCite|210|Taun We's Here}}</ref> Due to the character's heavy cloak, Owen only wore bicycle shorts and cozy pink slippers.<ref name="Nothing Up That Sleeve" />

While filming the landing platform scene, Owen asked director [[George Lucas]] if senators were allowed to smile and was told that they were;<ref name="MakingOf" /> indeed Alavar can be seen smiling in the final cut of the film.<ref name="ROTS" />
